title: Sticky context bar
description: The top of a list page that pins on scroll or search focus (250ms ease-out), holds against trackpad momentum and flings, and moves up to 2 page actions into SearchPill via BarActions while pinned. Pins by layout from md+ with independent overscroll-contained list/reader scrollers; keeps native touch scrolling below md.
when: A list, grid or table page with a search and filters people change while they scroll (customers, suppliers, products).
In place of a SubpageToolbar when the page needs the wide search and the chip row.

instead.need: A page with one or two filters and a few actions
The page's create action and refresh

a11y: With label it is a search landmark (role=search) named for the page, so screen-reader users jump to it.
BarActions hides its icon buttons out of flow and out of the accessibility tree while unpinned or while the search field has focus.
notes: One per page, right under the page heading: PageTitle with `actions` (the page's one `inverse` or `primary` action + `•••` / RefreshButton) or TextTabs. Pass `<BarActions actions={…} menu={…} />` in SearchPill's `trailing` slot so up to 2 icon buttons (`[•••][main action]`) appear inside the pinned search bar when the title row scrolls out of view.
1.0 list pages omit ResultLine: the list sits 16px under the filter row, and `sort` + `selection` ("Chọn", managed with `useListSelection`) live on FilterChipRow / PhoneFilterBar.
Desktop and iPad show FilterChipRow (max-md:hidden on the phone bar's sibling), phones PhoneFilterBar (md:hidden): same filters, same state.

The page's views (Đang mở · Đã đóng · Tất cả) are `SegmentedControl` in FilterChipRow `leading` on md+ and PhoneFilterBar `typeItems` (radio items) on phones: same state, usually a plain param (?view=) written with useFilterParams().setParams. The default view may be other than “all”; leave it out of the URL.
Phone chrome: at most 2 rows (search + PhoneFilterBar), under 25% of the viewport (P1).
